reliability.clears_floor_rule: held-out Spearman >= 0.2 AND the lower end of its 95% interval > 0, judged only with at least 12 runs and 3 CV groups
reliability.space_filling_advice: The model has not yet shown it can rank unseen runs (CV Spearman below the 0.2 floor, its 95% interval reaching 0, or too few runs to judge), so this batch explores rather than exploits. On data like this a space-filling design (e.g. Latin hypercube) is expected to do about as well; the model's advantage appears once it clears the floor.
